Notes.Text:
This update for emacs fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-96442: arbitrary code execution when viewing or editing untrusted text files in modes other than Emacs Lisp
  mode due to incomplete fix for CVE (bsc#1282390).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A code execution flaw was found in Emacs, affecting versions prior to 31.2. The Flymake mode using language backends other than Lisp would execute arbitrary code from the edited file while performing syntax checking. Viewing or editing untrusted files using Emacs could lead to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the user running Emacs.
